title: Which clients cover which parts of the ZIdentity API: Python, Go and the MCP server

prose.text: ZIdentity is automated through the Python SDK's `zid` package, the Go SDK's `ziam` services and, for reads, the MCP server. Each SDK's modules and functions are generated (`node scripts/kb.mjs surface zid`); this subject records the coverage differences an agent needs when choosing between them.

prose.label: User actions.
prose.text: {{go-user-actions}} {{python-no-user-actions}} The Go paths for these actions differ from the contract's: [[zidentity.sdk-go:user-action-paths]].

prose.label: Python SDK line.
prose.text: [[shared.sdk-python.client-configuration:legacy-clients]] The Python v2 beta covers ZIdentity together with ZIA and ZDX: [[cloud-connector.api.client-coverage:python-v2-excludes-ztw]].

prose.label: MCP server.
prose.text: {{mcp-toolsets}} {{mcp-read-only}} {{mcp-lean-summaries}} {{mcp-no-admin-objects}} The MCP server keeps ZIdentity tools only when the token's service list maps `ZIAM` to them: [[shared.mcp-server.tool-inventory:entitlement-aliases]].

python-no-user-actions.statement: Besides `__init__`, the Python users module (`UsersAPI`) defines only `list_users`, `get_user`, `add_user`, `update_user`, `delete_user` and `list_user_group_details`; none of them is a user action.

mcp-toolsets.statement: The MCP server's ZIdentity toolsets are `zid_groups` and `zid_users`, five tools each: get, list and search for groups and users, plus the members of a group and the groups of a user, each by ID or by name.

mcp-read-only.statement: The MCP tool catalog marks all ten ZIdentity tools Read-only.

mcp-lean-summaries.statement: The MCP list tools return lean summaries rather than the full SDK record: users as id, login name, display name and primary email, groups as id, name, description, dynamic flag and source IdP.

quotes: Returns lean user summaries (id, login name, display name, primary email) rather than the full SDK user record.
Returns lean group summaries (id, name, description, dynamic flag, source IdP) rather than the full SDK group record.

mcp-no-admin-objects.statement: No MCP tool reads or writes ZIdentity API clients, resource servers or user entitlements, and none writes users or groups.
mcp-no-admin-objects.conditions: The toolsets guide lists only these two ZIdentity toolsets, and the server's ZIdentity tool directory holds only groups.py and users.py at the pin.
